# istio_gateway (Data Source)

Read an existing Istio Gateway by name and namespace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "istio_gateway" "existing" {
  name      = "my-gateway"
  namespace = "istio-system"
}

output "gateway_manifest" {
  value = data.istio_gateway.existing.manifest
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Gateway resource.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the format `namespace/name`.
- `manifest` (String) Full Gateway manifest as a JSON string. Sensitive fields are redacted to "(redacted)".
